Dr. Alban Haxhiajdini

Founder & Lead Dentist of Jona Dent

Dr. Alban Haxhiajdini is a distinguished dentist from Peja, Kosovo, and the founder of Jona Dent, a modern dental clinic built around precision, aesthetics, advanced treatment, and an uncompromising commitment to patient satisfaction.

With a career in dentistry dating back to 2012, Dr. Haxhiajdini has spent more than a decade developing his expertise and bringing modern approaches to dental care to patients in Kosovo and from abroad. He is particularly recognized for his work in dental aesthetics, Hollywood Smile treatments, and implantology, combining clinical expertise with a strong understanding of facial aesthetics and the individual needs of each patient.

Through Jona Dent, his vision extends beyond traditional dental treatment. The clinic has developed a strong connection with international dental tourism, welcoming patients from across the region and from countries including Germany, Austria, Switzerland, and the United States. The experience is designed to make treatment abroad as seamless and comfortable as possible, with support that can include transportation, accommodation, and assistance throughout the patient's journey.

For Dr. Haxhiajdini, modern dentistry is not simply about treating teeth. It is about combining precision, technology, aesthetics, comfort, and personal care to create results that are both clinically considered and naturally beautiful. His approach is centered on understanding each patient's individual goals and creating treatment plans tailored to their needs, whether the goal is restoring function, improving a smile, or achieving a complete transformation.

Beyond his clinical work, Dr. Haxhiajdini has also demonstrated a commitment to the wider community. In 2025, he made a €3,500 donation to the Daily Center in Pljevlja, Montenegro, supporting the development of a Montessori classroom for children.

Jona Dent is his vision: a place where patients come not simply for treatment, but for an experience built around confidence, precision, and exceptional care.

Treatments

Every treatment is planned around your face, your bite and your goals. Open a row to read more.


Dental examination

Every journey starts with a thorough examination. We assess your teeth, gums and bite, look for problems early and listen to what you want. You leave with a clear, honest treatment plan, so you know what is needed, in what order and why.

Orthodontics

Crooked teeth and misaligned jaws can affect how you chew, clean and smile. We correct them with braces, clear aligners or other orthodontic appliances, planned around your face, your bite and the time you have.

Cosmetic dentistry

Cosmetic dentistry reshapes how your smile looks while respecting how your face looks. We combine whitening, veneers and bonding, and design each result to look natural, not generic.

Hollywood Smile

A Hollywood Smile is a complete smile makeover: the colour, shape, length and alignment of your front teeth are planned together, usually with veneers or crowns. Dr. Haxhiajdini designs it around your face, so the result looks like you, only brighter.

Implantology

Dental implants replace missing teeth with a fixed, natural-looking solution that restores chewing and confidence. Treatment is planned carefully and in stages, and the final restoration is matched to your other teeth.

Teeth whitening

Professional whitening lightens teeth safely, under dental supervision. We check your teeth and gums first so the result is even and comfortable, and we show you how to keep it.

Veneers

Veneers are thin shells bonded to the front of the teeth. They can change colour, shape, size and small gaps in one treatment, and are made to blend with your natural smile.

Dental bonding

Bonding uses tooth-coloured material to repair chips, close small gaps and reshape a tooth. It is often a quick, conservative option that keeps most of your natural tooth.

Dermal fillers

Offered alongside cosmetic dentistry, dermal fillers refine facial contours and lips, so your smile and your face are considered together.

The clinic

Jona Dent sits in Kompleksi Puhovci on Leke Dukagjini in Pejë. Inside, the clinic is designed to feel calm and modern: stone-look floors, soft lighting, a pastel tiled wall in the treatment rooms and a lobby with warm leather armchairs and plants, so the visit starts relaxed rather than clinical.

Each treatment room has its own screen and equipment within reach, and a team of dentists and assistants works together on every plan. For patients travelling from abroad, we help with dates, transport from Prishtina airport and accommodation, so you can focus on your treatment.
